input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the carve-out that transfers ownership of Developments created solely by Corio to Commerce One where Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis, since our playbook does not permit any assignment of our IP or work product to a vendor, and the carve-out gave us no licence back.
